title: Scalable KV quant profiles evaluation: calibration pipeline & latency/quality trade-offs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: run a reproducible set of KV-cache quantization experiments comparing INT8 and FP8 KV representations across model families and sequence-length distributions, validate accuracy degradation against prompt-level acceptance criteria, and measure end-to-end latency improvements at various batching configurations. Deliverable: calibration pipeline, experiment results (tables + plots), recommended quant profiles and safe fallbacks for runtime rollout.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A calibration pipeline that transforms representative KV traces into per-tensor quantization parameters for INT8 and FP8 and can be re-run against new workloads; 2) A test harness that computes relative perplexity/EM/LLR metrics across a curated prompt set and flags regressions >1.5% absolute or >5% relative; 3) Quant profiles with measured 95th percentile token-latency improvements and cost-per-token estimates; 4) A proposal for runtime rollout policy (canary thresholds and automatic fallback to FP16) submitted for review.
notes: We intentionally focus on KV quantization rather than full-weight quantization to optimize cache memory and KV bandwidth. Experiments will separate calibration artifacts (per-tensor scale/zero-point or exponent bias for FP8) from runtime clamp strategies. Use a mixed pipeline: profile collection -> offline calibration -> simulated decode evaluation -> in-situ runtime verification with small canary traffic.
experiment_plan: 1) Select 3 representative models (a 7B causal, a 13B encoder-decoder, a 70B causal) and two sequence-length distributions (interactive: 64-256, long-context: 1k-4k). 2) Collect KV traces from synthetic and production-like prompt sets (privacy-sanitized). 3) Run calibration for INT8 symmetric/asymmetric and two FP8 variants (E4M3 and E5M2). 4) Validate with our eval harness: token-level log-likelihood delta, downstream task accuracy (QA/NER/ranking), and human spot checks for hallucination patterns. 5) Measure throughput/latency across batching (1, 4, 8) and cache hit/miss scenarios. 6) Produce candidate quant profiles and run a 48h canary on dedicated infra with traffic shaping.
metrics_targets: Accuracy: <=1.5% absolute drop on core prompt set OR <=5% relative drop; Latency: >=10% reduction in median token-latency for batch=1 and >=20% for batch>=4 for INT8/FP8 candidate vs FP16 baseline; Memory: KV memory reduction target >=2x for best INT8 profiles. Cost: estimated per-token cost delta documented.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: INT8 may produce distributional outliers in rare long-context prompts causing local context drift. Mitigation: build automatic rollback on per-request LM score drop, add guardrails in runtime to detect sudden LLR drops and revert to FP16 for affected shards. Risk: FP8 variant subtle numerical instabilities for accumulation. Mitigation: add stress tests and compare token-wise deltas, disable FP8 for models with known sensitivity.
